_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Videotape Presentation
summary: The Technical Videotape Presentation provides visual, verbal, and written information about an event or presentation, used to assess or evaluate its results.
description_purpose:
The Technical Videotape Presentation provides visual, verbal and written information about an event or presentation.
This data product will be used to assess or evaluate the results of that event or presentation.
application_interrelationship: This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The event or presentation shall be prepared in contractor format using a video recorder, which includes audio recording.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The event or presentation shall contain the following:

children.title: Audio Recording.
children.content: A detailed, verbal narrative of the ongoing event or presentation which explains its purpose, observations, the sequence of events and conclusion(s).

children.title: Written Narrative.
children.content: A written narrative to familiarize the viewer with the contents of the tape (e.g., title, the objective(s), running time (hours or minutes), an outline, a detailed description of the event or presentation.)
